lines.en: label christmastwo15:
scene secretsantatime1
: Life can be all sorts of things. Happy. Sad. All of the emotions that occur in the middle-
lines.zh: : 生活可以是各种各样的东西。快乐的。悲伤的。以及介于两者之间的所有情绪——

lines.en: : But noodles will always be noodles.
lines.zh: : 但面条永远只是面条。

lines.en: : And once you lose sight of that, you have lost at both life and at Christmas.
lines.zh: : 而一旦你看不清这一点，你就同时在生活和圣诞节这两件事上都输了。

lines.en: : The moral of the story is to cherish your friends, because you never know when one of them might become a slice of pork or a cracked bowl.
lines.zh: : 这个故事的寓意是珍惜你的朋友，因为你永远不知道他们中的哪一个会变成一片猪肉，或者一只裂开的碗。

lines.en: : The end.
lines.zh: : 讲完了。

lines.en: : I forget. What was it we were talkin’ about again?
lines.zh: : 我忘了。我们刚才在聊什么来着？

lines.en: : I believe it was the topic of tradition. Though, I’m struggling to see how any of what was just said pertains to that.
lines.zh: : 应该是关于传统的话题。不过，我实在看不出刚才那番话跟传统有什么关系。

lines.en: : You should really consider putting more points into charisma next time, Kendo Princess. None of us understood any of that speech.
lines.zh: : 下次你真该考虑多加点魅力值，剑道公主。你那段演讲我们一个字都没听懂。

lines.en: scene secretsantatime2
: I apologize for derailing this conversation. I simply wanted to say that I would enjoy doing this again with all of you in the future.
lines.zh: : 抱歉把话题带偏了。我只是想说，我很乐意以后再和你们一起做这种事。

lines.en: : But, on the bright side, the mood seems to be a bit lighter now.
lines.zh: : 不过往好处想，气氛现在似乎轻松一点了。

lines.en: scene secretsantatime3
: Hey, yeah! It kinda does! Look at us, movin’ past all the bad stuff and gettin’ back to what {i}really{/i} brings all of us here today! Christmas!
lines.zh: : 嘿，对啊！确实是！看看我们，已经把那些糟心事翻篇，回到了今天{i}真正{/i}把我们聚在一起的东西上！圣诞节！

lines.en: : It’s gettin’ to be around time for Secret Santa, which I’m really friggin’ pumped about since I wasn’t able to do it with you guys last year.
lines.zh: : 快到 Secret Santa 的时间了，我真的超他妈的期待，因为去年我没能和你们一起做这个。

lines.en: : Aren’t we still missing a few people, though?
lines.zh: : 不过我们还缺几个人吧？

lines.en: scene secretsantatime4
: Are we? I saw Yumi walk back in a couple of minutes ago, so I kinda figured that was everybody.
lines.zh: : 缺吗？我几分钟前看到 Yumi 走回来了，所以我还以为人到齐了。

lines.en: : It looks like...several people are missing, actually. But we have more than half, so...
lines.zh: : 看起来……实际上少了好几个人。不过我们有一大半了，所以……

lines.en: : Are you still worried about whether or not the Herald of the Adolescents will enjoy your gift?
lines.zh: : 你还在担心那位“青春期使者”会不会喜欢你的礼物吗？

lines.en: scene secretsantatime5
: I’m more worried about whether or not he’ll ever like {i}me{/i} again. I rolled a nat-one when I tried talking to him the other night and I might have somehow made things even worse.
lines.zh: : 我更担心的是他还会不会再喜欢我。前几天晚上{i}我{/i}试着跟他说话，结果投出了个 natural 1，而且我好像还把事情弄得更糟了。

lines.en: scene secretsantatime6
: Well, {i}I{/i} am certainly excited for this gift exchange.
lines.zh: : 嗯，{i}我{/i}确实很期待这次的礼物交换。

lines.en: : It will be my first time receiving something from a classmate, so I’m sure that whatever gift I am given will find its place in a loving home.
lines.zh: : 这将是我第一次从同学手里收到东西，所以我相信无论我收到什么礼物，都会在一个充满爱的家里找到它的位置。

lines.en: : You haven’t gotten yours yet, Touka? I saw you carryin’ around a stuffed bear thingy before and kinda assumed that was just your present.
lines.zh: : 你还没拿到你的吗，Touka？我刚才还看见你抱着个毛绒熊什么的，还以为那就是你的礼物。

lines.en: : Oh, no. Not at all. That was-
lines.zh: : 哦，不。完全不是。那是——

lines.en: scene secretsantatime7
: Wait! Where did the bear go?! It was on the counter behind Tsuneyo just a moment ago!
lines.zh: : 等等！熊去哪儿了？！它刚刚还在 Tsuneyo 身后的柜台上！

lines.en: : It is likely gone forever.
lines.zh: : 它大概是永远地消失了。

lines.en: : Fission mailed.
lines.zh: : 任务失败。

lines.en: : No, no, no! That’s not good! It was my duty to look after it! We need to find it!
lines.zh: : 不，不，不！这可不好！保管它是我的职责！我们得把它找回来！

lines.en: : Ugh. Fine. But I’m only givin’ it five minutes before I pull the plug and start Secret Santa without it.
lines.zh: : 呃。行吧。不过我只给五分钟，时间一到我就叫停，没有它也要开始 Secret Santa。

lines.en: scene black
scene secretsantatime8
: Uhh...Sana?...
lines.zh: : 呃……Sana？……

lines.en: scene secretsantatime9
: Hm?
scene secretsantatime10
: Ah! Wha...what did I do? Why are you-
lines.zh: : 啊！什……我做了什么？你为什么——

lines.en: : I ain’t here to pick on you. Just heard some shit about my mom workin’ at your bar or whatever and I...wanted to see if it was true, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我不是来找你麻烦的。只是听到些风声，说我妈在你的酒吧干活什么的，我……想看看是不是真的。

lines.en: scene secretsantatime11
: So, you’re...not here to...pick on me?...
lines.zh: : 所以，你……不是来……找茬的？……

lines.en: : Have I ever picked on you before? Why the fuck would I start now?
lines.zh: : 我以前找过你麻烦吗？我他妈的为什么要现在开始？

lines.en: : You haven’t, but...I’m easy to miss, so...
lines.zh: : 你没有，可是……我很容易被忽略，所以……

lines.en: : Listen, I’m not plannin’ on bothering you or whatever. I just wanna know if the shit I’ve been hearin’ is true.
lines.zh: : 听着，我不打算打扰你什么的。我只是想知道我听到的那些事是不是真的。

lines.en: : You probably know her as Yuki. But I’ve known her since I was a kid and-
lines.zh: : 你可能知道她叫 Yuki。但我从小就认识她，然后——

lines.en: scene secretsantatime12
: Well...{i}obviously{/i} I’ve known her since I was a kid since she’s my fucking mom.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我{i}当然{/i}从小就认识她，她是我他妈的妈。

lines.en: : But, like...she ain’t ever worked a real job in her whole fuckin’ life. And I can’t figure out why the fuck she’d...start now instead of just doin’ what she’s always done.
lines.zh: : 可是，就像……她这辈子从来没干过一份正经工作。我搞不懂她为什么他妈的……现在要开始，而不是继续做她一直在做的事。

lines.en: : I’ve...heard from her that...you two aren’t on very good terms...
lines.zh: : 我……从她那里听说……你们俩关系不太好……

lines.en: scene secretsantatime13
: It’s true, then? She’s really working there? She like a...bodyguard or something?
lines.zh: : 那是真的了？她真的在那儿上班？她是那种……保镖什么的？

lines.en: : We aren’t...busy enough to hire any bodyguards...
lines.zh: : 我们……还没忙到要雇保镖……

lines.en: : She’s just a...normal bartender...
lines.zh: : 她只是个……普通的酒保……

lines.en: : She hasn’t...been there long, but...she’s doing her best...
lines.zh: : 她……去的时间不长，不过……她已经很努力了……

lines.en: : That’s...
lines.zh: : 那是……

lines.en: : I just don’t really get {i}why.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我只是真的不明白{i}为什么{/i}。

lines.en: : But I don’t really expect you to know either.
lines.zh: : 不过我也没指望你知道。

lines.en: scene secretsantatime14
: Uhh...anyway! That was pretty much it.
lines.zh: : 呃……总之！基本就是这样了。

lines.en: : I’m gonna...probably go back to the other room to chill with Chika for a bit, so as long as you ain’t got anything you need to ask me, I’ll-
lines.zh: : 我大概……要回另一个房间和 Chika 一起待一会儿，所以只要你没有别的事要问我，我就——

lines.en: scene secretsantatime15
: Attention, attention! All ladies and Sensei!
lines.zh: : 注意，注意！全体女士，还有老师！

lines.en: scene secretsantatime16
: I know we’re still missing a few people, but the time has come for us to give each other stuff so we don’t miss out on the fireworks later!
lines.zh: : 我知道我们还缺几个人，不过现在是时候互相送东西了，这样待会儿才不会错过烟花！

lines.en: : If the person you’re supposed to give a present to isn’t here, by no means give it to Touka! She has proven she can not be trusted with looking after presents!
lines.zh: : 如果你要送礼物的对象不在这儿，千万别把它交给 Touka！她已经证明了自己在保管礼物这件事上靠不住！

lines.en: : Uta, please! I’m sure it will turn up somewhere! I just have to-
lines.zh: : Uta，拜托！我肯定它会从哪儿冒出来的！我只要——

lines.en: : No excuses, bear killer!
lines.zh: : 少找借口，杀熊凶手！

lines.en: : Everyone, go! Go, go, go!
lines.zh: : 各位，动起来！快，快，快！

lines.en: scene black
One by one, all of the girls begin making their way over to the table that they’d left all of their gifts on shortly after entering the party.
lines.zh: 女孩们一个接一个地朝那张桌子走去——她们进派对后不久就把所有礼物都堆在了那里。

lines.en: Thankfully, I manage to avoid getting caught up in the congestion as I reclaimed Miku’s present from Touka (Unbeknownst to her) just a few minutes ago.
lines.zh: 幸好，我在几分钟前（她毫不知情）从 Touka 手里拿回了 Miku 的礼物，才没有被卷进那片拥堵里。

lines.en: Feeling ever so slightly bad about watching her frantically search the room for it, I let her know that it’s not lost after all and that she’s free to live at least a temporarily guilt free life.
lines.zh: 看着她发疯似的满屋子找，我心里多少有点过意不去，于是告诉她东西没丢，她至少可以暂时过上没有负罪感的生活。

lines.en: Touka breathes a sigh of relief and, without saying anything else, walks directly past me and over to an...extremely large gift wrapped object that I somehow did not notice at all tonight.
lines.zh: Touka 松了一口气，什么也没说，径直从我身边走过，走向一个……大得离谱的、包装好的物件——而我今晚居然完全没注意到它。

lines.en: Knowing that it’s time for me to actually be a decent person and give someone something, I glance over at Rin one final time to make sure she’s doing okay now.
lines.zh: 既然是时候让我真的当个正经人、给别人送点东西了，我最后看了 Rin 一眼，确认她现在没事。

lines.en: Futaba was able to calm her down for the most part. And I-
lines.zh: Futaba 基本上已经让她平静下来了。而我——

lines.en: Well, I was there.
lines.zh: 嗯，我当时在场。

lines.en: But that’s more than I can say most of the time.
lines.zh: 但这已经比我大多数时候能做的要多了。

lines.en: Now, I should probably get this bear over to Miku before I get sidetracked and-
lines.zh: 现在，我大概该在被别的事岔开之前，把这只熊送到 Miku 手里，然后——

lines.en: : Umm...Sir!
lines.zh: : 嗯……老师！

lines.en: Nevermind, I guess.
lines.zh: 算了，看来不行。

lines.en: scene secretsantatime17
: I know things are...not the best between us right now and...that you still haven’t...sorted out your feelings, but...
lines.zh: : 我知道我们现在之间……不太顺畅，而且你还没有……理清自己的感情，不过……

lines.en: : But I got this for you...
lines.zh: : 不过我还是给你买了这个……

lines.en: : You mean to tell me that the hypothetical scenario you threw out the other night about buying me a present was actually {i}true?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你是说，前几天晚上你随口说“给我买个礼物”的那个假设，居然是{i}真的{/i}？

lines.en: : S...Surprise~
lines.zh: : 惊……惊喜~

lines.en: scene secretsantatime18
: Thank you, Molly. I appreciate it.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Molly。我很感激。

lines.en: : This seems a little large to be a gift card, though.
lines.zh: : 不过这大小，好像不太像是礼品卡。

lines.en: : It’s actually...something I made. The mats for it did technically run a bit under the spending limit, but it took a little while to put together, so...I hope that makes up for the discrepancy in spending...
lines.zh: : 其实……是我做的。买材料的钱确实比限额低了一点，不过拼装花了不少时间，所以……我希望这能弥补花销上的差距……

lines.en: : Can I open it now?
lines.zh: : 我现在可以打开吗？

lines.en: scene secretsantatime19
: Now?! Why?!
lines.zh: : 现在？！为什么？！

lines.en: : Because it’s...a present for me?...
lines.zh: : 因为那是……给我的礼物？……

lines.en: : Yes! I mean no! Don’t open it!
lines.zh: : 对！我是说不对！别打开！

lines.en: scene secretsantatime20
: At the very least, Sir...please wait until you make it back home...
lines.zh: : 至少，老师……请等您回到家再打开……

lines.en: : It would be...a bit embarrassing seeing you try it on now...
lines.zh: : 现在看您试穿的话……会有点尴尬……

lines.en: : Please tell me you did not make me some sort of cosplay outfit.
lines.zh: : 请告诉我你没有给我做什么角色扮演服装。

lines.en: scene secretsantatime21
: Of course not. Though, it is certainly something in the...apparel family.
lines.zh: : 当然没有。不过，它确实算是……服饰一类的东西。

lines.en: : I just figured that since summer is right around the corner, this might come in handy.
lines.zh: : 我只是想着夏天马上就要到了，这个可能会派上用场。

lines.en: : So you don’t find it strange that summer is right around the corner from Christmas?
lines.zh: : 所以你不觉得“圣诞节之后马上就是夏天”这件事很奇怪？

lines.en: scene secretsantatime22
: That’s...
lines.zh: : 那是……

lines.en: : Wait...
lines.zh: : 等等……

lines.en: : Summer is still quite a way’s away if today is Christmas...
lines.zh: : 如果今天是圣诞节，那夏天还早得很呢……

lines.en: : So...{i}what?{/i} Why did I feel the need to make you-
lines.zh: : 所以……怎么回事？我为{i}什么{/i}会有那种冲动要给你做——

lines.en: : *Hic*
lines.zh: : *Hic*

lines.en: scene secretsantatime23
: You doing okay, Nodoka?
lines.zh: : 你还好吗，Nodoka？

lines.en: : I...{i}hic{/i}...held the glass for too long...
lines.zh: : 我……{i}嗝{/i}……举杯举太久了……

lines.en: : Is this what {i}normal{/i} people look like when they’re drunk?
lines.zh: : {i}正常{/i}人喝醉了就是这个样子吗？

lines.en: : She’s incredibly less annoying than I heard I was.
lines.zh: : 她比我听说中的我自己要可爱多了。

lines.en: : I say we don’t talk about how you are when you’re drunk.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我们还是别聊你喝醉什么样了。

lines.en: scene secretsantatime24
: Yes...right.
lines.zh: : 嗯……好吧。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, Sir...
lines.zh: : 对不起，老师……

lines.en: : You ever {i}hic{/i} take a second to think about how fucking {i}wild{/i} tardigrades are?
lines.zh: : 你有没有{i}嗝{/i}花一秒钟想过缓步动物有多他妈的{i}野{/i}？

lines.en: : They can live in fucking {i}lava.{/i} Can {i}you{/i} live in lava, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 它们能在他妈的{i}熔岩{/i}里活着。老师{i}你{/i}能在熔岩里活着吗？

lines.en: : Nodoka, when did this even happen to you? You were fine just a few minutes ago.
lines.zh: : Nodoka，你这是什么时候的事？几分钟前你还好好的。

lines.en: : I don’t remember. Some time after Otoha decided she didn’t want her parents knowing she fucks girls.
lines.zh: : 我不记得了。大概是在 Otoha 决定不想让她父母知道她操女生之后。

lines.en: scene secretsantatime25
: Uhh...okay. I’m going to walk away now. But...thank you for accepting my present, Sir. I...hope you enjoy it.
lines.zh: : 呃……好吧。我这就走开了。不过……谢谢你收下我的礼物，老师。我……希望你喜欢。

lines.en: : You can...let me know if...you ever decide to text me back.
lines.zh: : 如果……你哪天决定回我短信的话……可以告诉我。

lines.en: : Nooo, don’t go~
: I didn’t mean that Otoha is {i}actually{/i} fucking Rin. She just probably {i}thinks{/i} about fucking Rin.
lines.zh: : 我不是说 Otoha {i}真的{/i}在操 Rin。她大概只是{i}想着{/i}操 Rin。

lines.en: : But we {i}all{/i} think about fucking Rin. She’s Rin. She’s fuckable.
lines.zh: : 不过我们{i}都{/i}想着操 Rin。她就是 Rin。她很好操。

lines.en: : Nodoka...we are literally right here...
lines.zh: : Nodoka……我们可就在这儿啊……

lines.en: scene secretsantatime26
: Heeeeeey~
: Don’t “heeeeeey” me, please. Go get a bottle of water and lay down.
lines.zh: : 别“嘿—————呀”了，拜托。去拿瓶水躺下。

lines.en: : Can I lay on your lap?
lines.zh: : 我能躺你腿上吗？

lines.en: : No. I’m helping Rin right now.
lines.zh: : 不行。我现在在照顾 Rin。

lines.en: : Rin? You mean the fuckable one?
lines.zh: : Rin？你是说那个很好操的？

lines.en: : Is it weird that this is actually making me feel a little bit better right now?
lines.zh: : 说实话，这居然让我现在心情好了一点，是不是有点怪？

lines.en: : Merry Christmas, Sir. I’m walking away now.
lines.zh: : 圣诞快乐，老师。我这就走开了。

lines.en: : Yeah, so am I. As much as I like this conversation, this is probably the last place I should be getting involved in it.
lines.zh: : 我也是。虽然我很喜欢这段对话，但这大概是我最不该掺和进去的地方。

lines.en: scene black
Besides, I have other things to do right now and-
lines.zh: 再说，我现在还有别的事要做，然后——

lines.en: : Senpai!
lines.zh: : 前辈！

lines.en: scene secretsantatime27
: Nobody got me a Christmas present! This is the single worst party I’ve ever crashed! And I’ve crashed at least {i}three{/i} parties! Three!
lines.zh: : 没人给我圣诞礼物！这是我闯过的最糟糕的一场派对！而我至少闯过{i}三{/i}场！三场！

lines.en: : I’m going to go out on a limb here and assume that’s because you’ve been a part of the class for one day.
lines.zh: : 我大胆猜一下，那是因为你进这个班才一天。

lines.en: scene secretsantatime28
: Sure, yeah...but that doesn’t mean it doesn’t still hurt.
lines.zh: : 是啊，好吧……但这不代表它不伤人。

lines.en: : Will {i}you{/i} buy me a present, Senpai? Pleeeeeease?
lines.zh: : 前辈，{i}你{/i}能给我买个礼物吗？求——————你了？

lines.en: : No. Go away.
lines.zh: : 不行。走开。

lines.en: scene secretsantatime29
: Nothing?! Not even an innuendo for me to feed off of?!
lines.zh: : 什么都没有？！连一句能让我借题发挥的荤话都没有？！

lines.en: : I’m busy right now. Just let me drop this thing off and {i}then{/i} we can practice our...innuendo trading.
lines.zh: : 我现在很忙。先让我把这东西放下，{i}然后{/i}我们再来练习……荤话交换。

lines.en: scene secretsantatime30
: Fine. Give it here.
lines.zh: : 行。给我吧。

lines.en: : I’m a little too old for stuffed animals, but I guess this’ll have to do.
lines.zh: : 我年纪已经大到不太适合毛绒玩具了，不过我猜这个凑合吧。

lines.en: : Imani.
lines.zh: : Imani。

lines.en: : What, dude? You said you needed to drop that thing off. I’ve got arms. I can handle the drop.
lines.zh: : 干嘛，老兄？你说你得把那东西放下。我有胳膊。我能放。

lines.en: scene black
: Maybe next year.
lines.zh: : 也许明年吧。

lines.en: If she’s even still around next year.
lines.zh: 如果她明年还在这儿的话。

lines.en: Based on my current track record, though, I think it’s probably safe to assume she will be.
lines.zh: 不过照我目前的记录来看，我觉得大概可以安全地假设她会在。

lines.en: Unless tonight ends with another dramatic turn of events, of course.
lines.zh: 当然，除非今晚又来一次戏剧性的转折。

lines.en: But I should probably find a tomboy to give this bear to before that winds up being the case.
lines.zh: 但在那成为现实之前，我大概该找个假小子，把这只熊送出去。

lines.en: scene secretsantatime31
: Makoto, where-
lines.zh: : Makoto，你在——

lines.en: : Woah. What’s wrong?
lines.zh: : 哇哦。怎么了？

lines.en: : What am I supposed to do with this, Sensei?!
lines.zh: : 我该拿这个怎么办啊，老师？！

lines.en: : It’s a picture, so...I think you’re supposed to hang it up?
lines.zh: : 那是幅画，所以……我觉得你应该把它挂起来？

lines.en: scene secretsantatime32
: It’s worth a million yen! I’ve never even touched anything this expensive before!
lines.zh: : 它值一百万日元！我以前连这么贵的东西都没碰过！

lines.en: : That is well over the $20 spending limit.
lines.zh: : 那可远远超过 20 美元的限额了。

lines.en: : I knew something like this might happen when we set the limit in US dollars! Touka barely understands the value of {i}our{/i} currency, let alone a foreign one!
lines.zh: : 我就知道，当初把限额设成美元会出这种事！Touka 连{i}我们{/i}的货币值多少钱都搞不太懂，更别说外币了！

lines.en: : You know, I was wondering what the reasoning behind that was when I saw it written on the board the other day, but I decided against asking.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，那天我在黑板上看到这个规定的时候还纳闷为什么，不过我决定不问。

lines.en: : I need your help! I don’t know what to do with this thing!
lines.zh: : 我需要你帮忙！我不知道该怎么处理这东西！

lines.en: : I will gladly take it off your hands.
lines.zh: : 我很乐意替你接手。

lines.en: scene secretsantatime33
: Not that kind of help! I need your help returning it! I can barely even hold this thing up! It’s too heavy!
lines.zh: : 不是那种帮忙！我是要你帮我把它退回去！我连举都快举不动了！它太重了！

lines.en: : Yeah, it must be really tough having all of that wealth in the palms of your hands. Poor you.
lines.zh: : 是啊，掌心里攥着那么多财富，一定很辛苦。可怜的你。

lines.en: scene secretsantatime34
: Ugh...why did she think something like this was okay?
lines.zh: : 呃……她为什么会觉得送这种东西没问题？

lines.en: : That aside, have you seen Miku? I have to give her this present.
lines.zh: : 先不说这个，你看到 Miku 了吗？我得把这个礼物给她。

lines.en: scene secretsantatime35
: Miku? Yeah. She went outside to get some air a little while ago when things started getting loud.
lines.zh: : Miku？看到了。刚才开始变吵的时候，她出去透风了。

lines.en: : Is that...stuffed animal you’re carrying for her?
lines.zh: : 你抱着的是……给她的毛绒玩具？

lines.en: : Yeah. I didn’t really know what else to get and it kind of just jumped out at me.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我真不知道还能买什么，它就这么自己跳到我眼前了。

lines.en: : And you...didn’t think she was too {i}boyish{/i} to enjoy something like that?
lines.zh: : 而你……不觉得她太{i}男孩子气{/i}，不会喜欢这种东西？

lines.en: scene secretsantatime36
: I have no idea if she’ll enjoy it or not. It’s just what I bought. If she likes it, she likes it. If she doesn’t-
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道她喜不喜欢。这就是我买的东西。她喜欢就喜欢，不喜欢——

lines.en: : Makoto?
lines.zh: : Makoto？

lines.en: scene secretsantatime37
: She’s probably somewhere on the side of the hotel, where you can’t see any of the other buildings or cars or anything.
lines.zh: : 她大概在酒店的侧面，那边你看不到其他建筑，也看不到车，什么都看不到。

lines.en: : So...as far away from everything that she can possibly be right now without completely abandoning the party.
lines.zh: : 所以……在不彻底离开派对的前提下，她现在能离一切有多远就有多远。

lines.en: : Oh. Uhh, okay.
lines.zh: : 哦。呃，好吧。

lines.en: : I guess I’ll just head out there now then.
lines.zh: : 那我现在就过去吧。

lines.en: : And I’ll...be here. Stuck standing in place with this extremely valuable painting.
lines.zh: : 而我会……留在这儿。杵在原地，抱着这幅价值连城的画。

lines.en: : I believe in you, Makoto. If there’s anyone good at not being crushed by the weight of responsibility and obligation, it’s you.
lines.zh: : 我相信你，Makoto。如果说有谁擅长不被责任和义务的重量压垮，那就是你。

lines.en: scene secretsantatime38
: Okay. You can leave now.
lines.zh: : 好。你可以走了。

lines.en: : And I will do just that. See you later.
lines.zh: : 我正有此意。回头见。
